column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_charalist.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

column2: void * ui_call_draw_character_portrait_image(void *list, uint character, int x, int y, int scale, void *face_gim, void *body_gim)
column3: Copy of the rel_duel_draw wrapper (the decompiler shows only the call): calls ui_draw_character_portrait_image(list, character, x, y, scale, 0, 0, face_gim, body_gim). Returns the advanced list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_draw_confirm_face_body, ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

column2: void * ui_draw_character_portrait_image(void *list, uint character, int x, int y, int scale, int offset, int inset, void *face_gim, void *body_gim)
column3: Copy of the rel_duel_draw portrait drawer: nothing when a GIM is NULL; characters 0x79-0x8d and those whose world byte 9 is 5 use a fixed 0x33 x 0x54 tile of body_gim (column/row per id); others use world_get_character_model_ids (face index, body column, palette) for a 0x33 x 0x40 body tile and a 0x33 x 0x32 face tile at palette level, scaled by scale percent. Ninth argument on the stack. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_call_draw_character_portrait_image).

Module entry point of rel_charalist (ELF e_entry 0x4a8, which is 0x09eee8a8 at this module's base 0x09eee400), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).

Opens the character list: clears the 0x2f0-byte state 0x09efcd00, stores the mode (low nibble of byte +0; mode 3 and 4 also set bits 4-5 to 3), clears the selection (+0x34/+0x38 = -1), uses heap or, when NULL, creates an 8 MB FPL (sceKernelCreateFpl/AllocateFpl, ids +0x40/+0x44) with system_heap_create; ui_charalist_init_resources; modes 0/1 release all sound banks and load bank 0x2c8; font shadow, colour codes, ruby/trim per language. No return value. Side effects: state block, heap/FPL, sound banks, font flags. Exported; called from rel_story (1: world_state_start_charalist), rel_title (6: ui_title_update_charalist, ui_title_update_wireless_partner_pick, ui_minigame_menu_update_opponent_select, ...), rel_labo (1).

8-byte export that runs ui_charalist_update_ex(0) (the decompiler shows the shared body). Returns 0 while running, 1 when a choice was made, 2 when cancelled. Side effects: as ui_charalist_update_ex. Exported; called from rel_story (1: world_state_update_charalist), rel_title (7: ui_title_update_charalist, ui_title_update_comm_partner_pick, ...), rel_labo (1).

State machine on +0x02 (force_close jumps to state 8 once past state 1): 0 waits for charalist.ehp (ui_charalist_poll_resources), builds the lists, fades in, prepares the menu bar block 0x09efcea0 (EHF 4, frames 0-0x1df), starts track 2 in modes 0/1 and saves the volume setting; 1 waits for the fade, then 2 (mode 5) or 3; 2 ui_charalist_update_notice; 3 ui_charalist_update_list (not when force_close); 4 ui_charalist_update_profile; 5 waits 0x11 frames and fades out; 6 after the fade opens the partner confirm page (mode 3, not cancelled) as state 7, else 8; 7 runs it (result 3 back to state 0, 2 to state 8); 8 frees the lists and returns 1 (chosen) or 2 (cancelled, bit 0 of +0x30). Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: state block, sound, fades, save data (partner). Exported; called from rel_title (1: ui_title_update_wireless_partner_pick); 2 further import stubs.

Unless the mode is 2 or 5, first waits for the file thread and closes the resources (ui_charalist_try_close; returns 0 while busy). Then frees each tab's profile records (entries without flag bit 2) and entry arrays, and, when an FPL was created, frees and deletes it. Returns 1 when done. Side effects: heap, FPL, resources. Callers: 3 (ui_charalist_pick_random_character, ui_charalist_update_ex, ui_charalist_free).

Export (NID e11636ec): without UI, sets mode 2, builds the lists from heap and picks a random entry of tab 0 or 1 (stopping the count after tab 1) with a random variant (or the only one) until ui_charalist_is_character_selectable(0, character, variant) holds; stores it in +0x34/+0x38 (0/0 when the lists are empty) and frees the lists. No return value. Side effects: state block, heap. Exported; called from rel_title (2: ui_title_get_charalist_choice, ui_title_refresh_comm_player_slot).

Export (NID 953239e8): clears the state, sets mode 2, clears the selection, stores heap and builds the three tab lists without any UI (for ui_charalist_select_entry_by_index). No return value. Side effects: state block, heap. Exported (3 import stubs without callers).

Export (NID df67151f): finds entry index across the three tab lists in order; writes its character to *out_character and the selection +0x34; for a profile entry with one variant uses bits 6-8 of the record's first halfword as the variant, with more variants writes the count to *out_variant_count and picks a random variant number; applies ui_charalist_fix_variant. Returns 1 when the index exists, else 0. Side effects: +0x34/+0x38, outputs. Exported (3 import stubs without callers).

Library export (NID 0x558dbb5f, shown as ui_charalist_free): tail-jumps to ui_charalist_free_lists (unrelocated j 0x9e8 = 0x09eeede8). Returns its result: 0 while the file thread is still busy, 1 when every list and the FPL are freed. Side effects: those of ui_charalist_free_lists (heap, FPL, resources). No direct caller in the module (exported; no importing caller identified).

Returns the selected character +0x34, or -1 when the list was cancelled (bit 0 of +0x30). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex); exported, called from rel_title (7: ui_title_get_charalist_choice, ui_title_apply_wireless_partner_pick, ...).
Returns the selected variant +0x38, or -1 when cancelled. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex); exported, called from rel_title (6: ui_title_get_charalist_choice, ...).

Draw export: clears layer 0 to black; outside states 0 and 8 sets the 2D state on layer 4 and either draws the partner confirm page (state 7) or the list screen: menu bar EHF, header bar (modes 0/1, list 12 px lower), tab panel (0x22, y, 0x19c, 0xf9), scroll bar, up to four rows (0x38 px apart), then the profile (state 4: dim by open animation and bust-up) or the cursor frame, and in state 2 the notice window; then the fade on layer 5. No return value. Side effects: GE layers 0, 4, 5. Exported; called from rel_story (1) and rel_title (4: ui_title_draw_state, ...).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_tab_panel(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws the list panel frame (resource 0x1002, 6 x 6 corners, palette row = tab * 0x20) and the three tab headers splitting width, the current tab (+6 & 3) white, others grey and lower with a scissor, labels card_db_get_dictionary_word(resource 0x1020, 0x3f + tab). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT pixel wrapper (identical code, tail call): system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_draw_tab_panel, ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_list_row(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int show_flag, int show_record, void *entry)
column3: Draws one list row: frame pieces (resource 0x1003) across width, the row body at (x + 6, y + 4), then optionally the flag icon at x + 0x138 and the duel record box. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_row_body(void *list, int x, int y, void *entry)
column3: Draws a 12-byte list entry: background, the list number (+2 & 0x3ff, swprintf), two labels (dictionary 0xc and 4), the character name of the current variant, the category bar (byte +0x20 of the record, or the entry byte for simple entries), and in a 0x28 scissor either the portrait (simple entries: resources 0x1006/0x1007) or the face icon from world_get_character_byte_3f (highlighted while it is the chosen one in state 5) plus left/right arrows to the neighbouring variants. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_list_row).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT pixel wrapper (identical code, tail call): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 4 (ui_charalist_draw_row_body, ui_charalist_draw_category_bar, ui_charalist_draw_voice_bar, ui_charalist_draw_character_name).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_row_flag_icon(void *list, int x, int y, void *entry)
column3: Draws a 0x1e x 0x2c icon (resource 0x1003 at u 0x40) and, when save_test_character_flag_bit2(character, current variant) is set, a 0x1e x 0x1c overlay. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_list_row).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_row_duel_record(void *list, int x, int y, void *entry)
column3: Draws a 0x29 x 0x2e box and the three counters save_get_duel_count_vs(0, 1, 2, character) right-aligned at y + 1, + 0x10, + 0x1f (win/loss/draw order unconfirmed). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_list_row).

column2: void ui_charalist_draw_number(int right_x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value (capped at 999) as decimal digits right-aligned at right_x, 8 px per digit, through ui_list_window_draw_text. No return value. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_draw_row_duel_record, ui_charalist_draw_voice_bar).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT wrapper (identical code; the decompiler shows only the argument shifts): system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_draw_number, ui_charalist_draw_header).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_cursor_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws the selection frame (resource 0x1003 corners and edges) around (x, y, width, height), growing by 2 px every other 8 frames (frame counter bit 3). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

column2: void ui_charalist_draw_character_name(int x, int y, int width, ushort character, ushort variant)
column3: Draws world_call_get_character_name_string(0, character, variant) fitted to width; in Japanese enables ruby and moves the text up by the extra line height. No return value. Side effects: text drawn, ruby off afterwards. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_category_bar(void *list, int x, int y, int text_x, ushort kind)
column3: Draws a 0xcb-pixel bar (resource 0x1003) tinted by kind (GE colours are 0xAABBGGRR: 1 red 0xff7e7fff, 2 yellow 0xff87e9f5, 3/4 blue 0xffffafa0, other pale beige 0xffa7d2e9) and the dictionary word table 0x09efbbf8[kind] (resource 0x1020) at x + text_x. Meaning of kind (world byte 9 of the variant) not established. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_scroll_arrow(void *list, int x, int y, char down, uint period, int visible, int show_base, uint time, void *gim)
column3: Draws an 8 x 8 arrow of gim (down arrows 8 px lower in the texture): the base sprite when show_base, and when visible the highlight with alpha following a triangle wave of time % period. Ninth argument on the stack. Returns the list pointer (hypothesis from the caller, medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_scrollbar).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_scrollbar(void *list, int x, int y, int height, int position, int visible, int total, uint frame)
column3: Draws a vertical scroll bar (resource 0x1003): track, thumb of length visible * (height - 2) / total (at least 10) at position, thumb style alternating with frame bit 0, and up/down arrows shown when scrolling is possible, pulsing with the frame rate. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).
Returns word +4 of the frame timing record (system_get_frame_timing). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_scrollbar).

Draws the 480-pixel title bar at the top (resource 0x1003 pieces) and the dictionary word 0xb in white at (8, 4). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

Draws an untextured full-screen 480 x 272 quad with colour alpha << 24 (black), then restores texturing and white ambient. Returns the list pointer (hypothesis from the caller, medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

Draws the profile overlay of the current entry: the bust-up and, for profile entries whose record byte +1 has bit 1 set, the voice test bar for voice index +0x14. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

When the bust-up EHFs of entry are loaded (ui_charalist_get_bustup_ehf 0 and 1), draws body and mouth with ui_ehf_draw at x = target - slide, the slide +0x4c easing (at most 0x21 px per frame) towards open animation +0x4a * end / 12 (target 400, or 0x208 with end 0x294/0x28a/0x280 for characters 0x2b, 0x24 variant 1 and 0xc); during a pose switch (+0x4e) it applies the alpha +0x4f. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: +0x4c, GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_profile).

Draws the voice test bar (resource 0x1008, rising with the open animation), blinking left/right arrows when index can move within the count +0x68, and, unless voice banks are loading, the number index + 1 and the dictionary word table 0x09efbc2c[voice list 0x09efcd6a[index]]. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE and font state. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_profile).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_face_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int icon, int highlighted)
column3: Draws cell icon (0x28 x 0x28, 12 per row) of resource 0x1004, or 0x1005 when highlighted. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

column2: void * ui_charalist_draw_variant_arrow(void *list, int x, int y, int icon, int right)
column3: Draws a 0xd x 0xd frame, a blinking left or right arrow, and a 10 x 10 scaled cell icon (resource 0x1004) of the neighbouring variant. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw_row_body).

Builds the three tab lists: for characters 2-0x8e that are listed (ui_charalist_is_character_listed), counting each as list number 1, 2, ..., keeps those with at least one variant unlocked for the mode (save_test_character_flag_bit3 in modes 0/1, bit0 in mode 2, bit1 in modes 3/5, byte1_bit0 in mode 4) and appends (number, id) to tab 0 (category 2), tab 1 (category 0) or tab 2 (others) by world_get_character_category; allocates the 12-byte entry arrays (+0x1c[3]) and fills tabs 0/1 with profile entries and tab 2 with simple entries, storing the counts in +0x16[3]. No return value. Side effects: heap, state block. Callers: 3 (ui_charalist_pick_random_character, ui_charalist_update_ex, ui_charalist_build_lists_headless).

List input (state 3). Cancel (except mode 3 where it is checked after the other keys): fade out, state 6, sound 0x7a06; modes 0/1 stop the music, modes 2/4/5 set the cancelled bit. L / R (pad 0x100 / 0x8200) change tab; repeat bits 0x10/0x40 move the row (4 visible, wrap on a new press), 0x80/0x20 change the variant of a profile entry (record byte 0 bits 3-5); confirm on an entry: modes 0/1 open the profile (state 4; simple entries only for ids above 0x7e), modes 2-5 store character/variant and go to state 5; an empty tab plays 0x7a07. No return value. Side effects: state block, profile records, sounds, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).

State 2 (mode 5): sub-state 0 resets the profile counters and opens the notice window 0x09efcea4 with text 0x42 of the mini_result table (ui_charalist_get_result_text(block, 0xc, language, 0x42)); sub-state 1 updates it and on result 1 or 4 goes to state 3. No return value. Side effects: list window, state words. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).

Profile page (state 4) of the current entry: polls voice bank loading (bit 0 of +0x60), ramps the music volume (+0x66: 1 down to a third, 2 back up, over 12 frames); sub-state 0 measures the text, then (record byte +1 bit 1 and no sound playing) loads the voice banks and builds the voice list; 1 waits 2 frames; 2 runs the open animation +0x4a to 12; 3 handles input: cancel closes (voices stopped, banks released, sound 0x7a06, volume restored), SELECT-like bit 0x8000 starts a pose switch, the analogue y (pad +0x14) and up/down scroll the text +0x28 within +0x2c; with a voice list, confirm plays voice list[+0x14] (and queues its second sound), L/R/left/right move by 10 or 1; 4 runs the close animation and returns to state 3. No return value. Side effects: state block, sound banks and volume. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).

For each (number, character) pair whose character exists (world_find_character), allocates a 0x44-byte profile record: byte 0 bits 0-2 variant count and 3-5 current variant, +2 world byte +0x3f, then per unlocked variant v (same mode flags as ui_charalist_build_lists) +4[v] variant number, +0xc[v] world_get_character_word_0c (bust-up name), +0x20[v] world byte 9, +0x28[v] the dictionary text 0x09efbf50[character * 4 + v] (resource 0x1020) and +0x3c[v] the character id; writes the entry (+0 id, +2 number, flag bit 2 clear, +8 record). Returns the number of entries. Side effects: heap, entries. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_build_lists).

Writes one 12-byte entry per (number, character) pair with flag bit 2 set (+3) and world_get_character_byte_09(character, 0) in byte +8 instead of a record pointer. Returns count. Side effects: entries. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_build_lists).

Moves the bust-up body and mouth EHFs to the start of the next 15-frame group (wrapping at the frame count; the group at frame 0x96 is skipped for character 4 with variant != 0). When the entry has a record (entry byte +3 bit 2 clear) whose byte +1 bit 1 is set, characters 0x26 and 0x25 also switch the record's voice key (+0x3c: 0x26 to 0x29 at frame 0x2d and back at other frames; 0x25 to 0x2c at frame 0x1e and back) and the selected variant 0x09efcd38; on a switch it stops the playing voices (audio_stop_sounds_voice), reloads the voice banks and rebuilds the voice list. No return value. Side effects: EHF play ranges, record +0x3c, 0x09efcd38, voices, voice banks. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_profile).

With the profile font state (shadow, scale 0xe, ruby in Japanese), measures the current variant's text (+0x28) with ui_charalist_measure_text_height at width 0x4180, and sets the text scroll limit 0x09efcd2c to height - 0x2640 (at least 0) and the scroll 0x09efcd28 to 0. No return value. Side effects: those words, font flags restored. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_profile).

Returns the height in 1/64 pixel of text wrapped to width: tail-jumps to system_font_split_lines(width, text, 0, 0) (same code as BOOT.BIN system_font_measure_text_height). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_measure_profile_text).

For a profile entry whose "%s_voiceidchgtbl.bin" member exists, collects every index i < 0x86 of the voice table 0x09efbd38 (4-byte entries: sound number, second sound) with a non-negative sound that ui_charalist_is_voice_available accepts into the list 0x09efcd6a; count +0x68, index +0x14 = 0. No return value. Side effects: voice list. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_update_profile, ui_charalist_switch_bustup_pose).

Releases the previously loaded voice banks when they differ, loads the four extra banks audio_get_voice_extra_bank .. + 3 and the voice bank audio_get_voice_bank(character, variant), remembers them (+0x50-+0x5c) and sets the loading bit 0 of +0x60. No return value. Side effects: sound banks, state words. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_update_profile, ui_charalist_switch_bustup_pose).
Releases the four extra banks and the voice bank and resets +0x50/+0x54 to 0 and +0x58/+0x5c to -1. No return value. Side effects: sound banks. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_profile).

column2: int ui_charalist_get_voice_sound_id(int character, int variant, int index)
column3: Returns the sound id of voice index: index < 5 counts from the first sound of the extra bank, otherwise index - 5 from the first sound of the voice bank (audio_get_bank_first_sound_id). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_profile).

column2: bool ui_charalist_is_voice_available(int character, int variant, int index)
column3: Accepts voice table entry index by its sound number s: character 0x12 needs s <= 0x95, 5 needs s != 0x95 (and s <= 0x95 for variants != 0), 6 needs s <= 0x94 and not 0x95 in variant 2, others s <= 0x94. Returns the verdict. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_build_voice_list).

Marks charalist.ehp (0x09efcff0) and the bust-up loader (0x09efcff8) idle, clears the 0x166c-byte bust-up cache and sorts the 9-entry resource table 0x09efc13c (12-byte entries: id, cached member, name format) by id with system_qsort. No return value. Side effects: those blocks. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_open).

Starts loading charalist.ehp (ui_charalist_get_archive) and returns 1 on the call after the load counter (bits 1-7 of 0x09efcff0) became non-zero (resetting it), else 0. Side effects: 0x09efcff0. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).
When container_is_file_thread_busy() is 0, closes the resources (ui_charalist_close) and returns true; otherwise false. Side effects: heap. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_free_lists).

Frees charalist.ehp (0x09efcff4), every cached bust-up file (0x8f characters x 5 variants, 0x14-byte rows at 0x09efcff8) and the decompressed bust-up 0x09efe658 to the heap. No return value. Side effects: heap, those pointers. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_try_close); exported, called from rel_title (4: ui_title_close_wireless_charalist, ui_title_enter_state, ...).

Returns the charalist.ehp buffer 0x09efcff4; on the first call (loader idle) allocates it and starts container_load_file(3, "database/charalist.ehp") with ui_charalist_on_archive_loaded, returning 0. Side effects: heap, file load. Callers: 4 (ui_charalist_get_resource, ui_charalist_find_voice_table, ui_charalist_update_ex, ui_charalist_poll_resources).

Looks id up in the sorted resource table 0x09efc13c (shop_bsearch_resource_table, 9 entries of 12 bytes); returns the cached member or finds it in charalist.ehp by sprintf(name format of the entry, language letter from the 6-character table 0x09efc1c0) and caches it. Returns NULL for an unknown id or while the archive is missing. Side effects: cache. Callers: 13 (ui_charalist_draw_tab_panel, ui_charalist_draw_list_row, ui_charalist_draw_row_body, ui_charalist_draw_scrollbar, ...).

Returns body.ehf (which 0) or mouth.ehf (1) of the entry's current bust-up: when it is the loaded one (key 0x09efe654) returns the cached pointer; when its file is cached, gzip-decompresses it into 0x09efe658, binds it, finds body.ehf/mouth.ehf (play range 0-1) and updates the key; otherwise starts loading field/bustup/<name> (name from the record +0xc[v] or world_get_character_word_0c) into the cache 0x09efcff8 and returns NULL. Side effects: heap, cache, file load. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_draw_bustup, ui_charalist_switch_bustup_pose).

Builds the prefix 0x09efc1f0 + world_get_character_cutin_name(character, variant) and returns the charalist.ehp member "<that>_voiceidchgtbl.bin" (NULL when absent or not loaded). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_build_voice_list).

Load callback of charalist.ehp: when size > 0 binds the EHP and increments the counter in bits 1-7 of 0x09efcff0; always sets bit 0 (idle). Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x09efcff0, binding. No direct caller (load callback).
Load callback of a bust-up file: sets bit 0 of 0x09efcff8 (loader idle). Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x09efcff8. No direct caller (load callback).
Comparator: returns *a - *b. No side effects. No direct caller (qsort callback of ui_charalist_init_resources).

column2: int shop_bsearch_resource_table(ushort id, void *table, int count, int entry_size)
column3: Binary search of id in count entries of entry_size bytes sorted by the u16 at +0; returns the index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_get_resource).

column2: void ui_charalist_open_partner_confirm(void *heap, void *archive, int character, int variant)
column3: Allocates the 0x1a0-byte confirm work area 0x09efe664 from heap (+0 heap, +4 archive = charalist.ehp) and initialises it for character/variant. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x09efe664. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).
Frees the confirm work area to the heap stored in its first word (pointer not cleared). No return value. Side effects: heap. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).

Loads menu bars 0 (frames 0-0x10, play) and 1 (0-0x1df), the six confirm GIMs (+0x170; index 5 per language), stores character/variant (+0x20/+0x24), writes the default team name, sets the page state +0x14 = 1 and fades in. No return value. Side effects: work area, save team name, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_open_partner_confirm).

Builds the default team name in a zeroed 0x200-byte buffer: player name (save_get_player_name), the separator string at 0x09efc20c (one character, 0x0026, and its terminator) and the partner name world_call_get_character_name_string(2, character, variant) with ruby stripped, and stores it with save_set_team_name. A last wcscat of an empty string at character 17 only rewrites a terminator that is already there, so the name is not cut (hypothesis, confidence medium: a length limit meant as buf[17] = 0). No return value. Side effects: save data. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_init_partner_confirm).

Calls save_copy_partner_field into a scratch word and save_set_partner(character, variant) from the confirm work area. No return value. Side effects: save data. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

Per-frame confirm step: in keyboard mode (+0x10 = 1) runs ui_charalist_update_team_name_input and returns 1; in page mode returns ui_charalist_update_confirm_page. Returns 1 while running, 2 when accepted, 3 when cancelled. Side effects: as the callees. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_ex).

Switch on +0x14: 2 intro (returns 1), 3 prompt, 4 warning, 7 close, 8 waits 0x1f frames then 9, 9 exit poll, 10 commits the partner (save_commit_partner_choice) and returns the result +0x19c (2 accept, 3 cancel); states 0, 1, 5, 6 return 1, unknown states 0. Side effects: work area, save data. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_partner_confirm).

When menu bar 0 reaches frame 0x10, starts its frames 0x11-0x60; from frame 0x10 on sets state 3 and opens the confirm prompt window (+0x28). No return value. Side effects: work area, list window. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

Updates the prompt window and, once it is shown (+0x111 > 2), reads the input: cancel -> state 9, result 3, fade out; confirm -> state 5 (team-name keyboard after the fade); START -> with a non-blank team name state 8, result 2, fade out, else state 4 and the warning window; any choice starts closing the window. No return value. Side effects: work area, window, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

Updates the warning window and, when it reports closed (+0x111 = 6), sets state 5 and fades out (to the keyboard). No return value. Side effects: work area, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

Reads newly pressed buttons: START (bit 8) returns 1 and confirm returns 2 (sound 0x7a05), cancel returns 3 (sound 0x7a06), nothing 0. Side effects: sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_prompt).

State 7: updates the window and, once closed with a non-blank team name, plays menu bar frames 0x61-0x65 and sets state 9. No return value. Side effects: work area. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

State 9: tail-jumps to ui_charalist_get_menu_bar_frame(0), so it returns the current frame of menu bar 0 or -1; its only caller ignores the value. The state ends in ui_charalist_draw_partner_confirm when the fade finishes. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_page).

Returns 1 when the saved team name (first 16 characters) contains a character other than space or U+3000, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_charalist_update_confirm_prompt, ui_charalist_update_confirm_close).

In page mode draws menu bar 1 (and 0 from state 2), the title from state 3, the frames, portraits, names and the window (centred in state 4), then advances fade-driven states: 9 -> 10 when the fade is done, 6 or 1 -> 2, 5 -> keyboard mode state 0. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: work area, GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

Keyboard mode: state 0 starts ui_start_osk_input(team name buffer, title text 0x45, 0x11, ui_charalist_on_team_name_entered) and sets state 1; state 2 returns to page mode state 6. No return value. Side effects: keyboard block, work area. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_update_partner_confirm).

Returns text number of the confirm text table: member strTbl_<l>.bin (six 0x40-byte names at 0x09efc210, picked by save_get_language) of the confirm archive, through card_db_get_dictionary_word (return from the callers, medium). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_charalist_update_team_name_input, ui_charalist_open_confirm_prompt, ui_charalist_open_team_name_warning).

Keyboard callback: when word +0x148 of the work area is 1 sets it to 2 (nothing in this module sets it to 1; hypothesis that it is unused, medium). No return value. Side effects: +0x148. No direct caller (callback of ui_start_osk_input).
In keyboard mode state 1 runs ui_update_osk_input(4); when it reports finished returns to page mode state 6. Returns list unchanged. Side effects: work area, keyboard. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_draw).

Returns member index of the 11-name table starting with d_menu01.gim (0x40-byte names at 0x09efc390) in the confirm archive (return from the caller). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_charalist_init_partner_confirm).

Returns word +0x170 + 4 * index of the work area (the six confirm GIMs). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_charalist_draw_confirm_title, ui_charalist_draw_confirm_portraits, ui_charalist_draw_confirm_frames).
